title: Preparation of f/2 Medium for Algal Cultures
author: Roscoff Culture Collection
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s26eghe
materials: Marine Water Enrichment Solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #G0154-500ML

steps.title: Filter seawater
steps.instruction: Filter 1 L of old seawater (collected at least two months ago) first through a prefilter and then through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Pasteurize seawater
steps.instruction: Heat the filtered seawater for 10–20 minutes at 100 °C to pasteurise.

steps.title: Cool seawater
steps.instruction: Allow the pasteurised seawater to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add enrichment solution
steps.instruction: Under a laminar‑flow hood, add 25 mL of Guillard’s (f/2) Marine Water Enrichment Solution (Sigma‑Aldrich product G9903).

steps.title: Final filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the medium through a 0.2 µm filter using Guillard’s (F/2) Marine Water Enrichment Solution from Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma‑Aldrich) catalog #G0154‑500ML.
